name: Hitogotchi
source:
The idea was supposed to be a reversed Tamagotchi, where you ask for things to the person taking care of you. Somewhere along the way, I got too into dialogues so.. this happened.

[From [url=https://onionblaze.itch.io/hitogotchi]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
原本的构想是做一款反向电子宠物：由照顾你的人向你索取东西。后来我太沉迷于对话了，于是……变成了现在这样。

[来源：[url=https://onionblaze.itch.io/hitogotchi]Itch.io[/url]]
